title: Resource Theory of Aquaternionicity: Every Pure State Is a Replicable Resource for Exact Simulation of Arbitrary Quantum Operations
summary: An alchemical resource theory admits a nonfree state that can be exactly replicated by free operations and whose finitely many copies enable exact simulation of arbitrary quantum instruments. The only known nontrivial examples, imaginarity and parity asymmetry, exhaust the qubit case (arXiv:2609.12988) and exhibit an all-or-nothing property: any nonmaximal resource exactly simulates only free unitaries.
